source.publication: 2025 Kentucky Form 740 packet with instructions (Kentucky Department of Revenue), with 2025 Form 740, Schedule M, Schedule P and Schedule ITC
source.section: Form 740 (2025) page 1 lines 5-19 and page 2 lines 20-22 (740_2025.pdf PDF pp.1-2); packet PDF p.13 Line 5, Lines 6-9 (Kentucky AGI), Line 10 'Nonitemizers, enter the standard deduction of $3,270 ... If filing a joint return, only one $3,270 standard deduction is allowed', Line 11, Line 12 'Multiply line 11 by four percent (.04)'; packet PDF p.3 'For 2025, the standard deduction is $3,270' and 'the tax rate for individual income tax is 4%'; Schedule M (2025) PDF p.1 line 1 and PDF p.2 Line 1 (interest from other states' bonds added; Kentucky bond interest exempt); Schedule ITC (2025) PDF p.2 Section B line 1 (taxpayer) and line 5 (spouse) 'If you were 65 on or before 12/31/2025, enter 40'; Form 740 lines 16-18 (line 18: if line 17 is larger than line 16, enter zero); packet PDF p.14 Line 17; Schedule ITC (2025) PDF p.2 Section C Family Size Tax Credit Table (family size one: not over 15,650 100% ... over 20,815 0; family size two: not over 21,150 100% ... over 28,130 0); packet PDF p.26 Worksheet for Computation of Modified Gross Income lines (a)-(j) and Section C family size definitions; packet PDF p.11 Modified Gross Income; packet PDF p.14 Line 20 and Line 21 (MGI 42,760 or less); Form 740 page 2 lines 20-22 (line 21: line 19 times the decimal from Schedule ITC)

worked: Single, 45, wages 15,000 and interest 1,000 from another state's municipal bonds. The muni interest is not in federal AGI but is added on Schedule M line 1 and counts in MGI (worksheet line (c)), lifting MGI from 15,000 to 16,000, over the 15,650 threshold: 90% instead of 100%. Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = wages (person 0) 15,000.00 = 15,000.00 (municipal interest 1,000.00 is not in federal AGI). Federal taxable income = 15,000.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 = -750.00 floored at 0.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). Form 740, Filing Status 1 (single). Line 5 federal AGI 15,000.00. Schedule M line 1 interest from other states' bonds 1,000.00; line 6 total additions 1,000.00. Form 740 line 6 1,000.00; line 7 = 15,000.00 + 1,000.00 = 16,000.00. Schedule M line 17 total subtractions 0.00; Form 740 line 8 0.00. Line 9 Kentucky AGI = 16,000.00 - 0.00 = 16,000.00. Line 10 standard deduction 3,270.00; line 11 taxable income = 16,000.00 - 3,270.00 = 12,730.00. Line 12 tax = 12,730.00 x 0.04 = 509.20; lines 13 and 15 0.00; line 14 and line 16 509.20. No one is 65 or older: line 17 0.00; line 18 = line 16. Line 19 = 509.20. Modified gross income worksheet: (a) 15,000.00; (c) non-Kentucky municipal interest 1,000.00; (e) 16,000.00; (f) Kentucky AGI 16,000.00; (i) 16,000.00; (j) greater = 16,000.00. Line 20 family size 1 (single, no qualifying children); Schedule ITC Section C table: MGI 16,000.00 is over 15,650 but not over 16,276, so 90% (.90); line 21 = 509.20 x 0.9 = 458.28. Line 22 = 509.20 - 458.28 = 50.92. Credits = 0.00 + 458.28 = 458.28; state income tax 50.92. The form enters whole dollars; expected keeps the formula result to the cent.
